newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran President inaugurates coal tar refinery.
newsitem.headline: Iran President inaugurates coal tar refinery.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Tuesday inaugurated a 100,000 tonnes a year coal tar refinery in the Iranian city of Isfahan, the official Iran news agency IRNA reported on Tuesday.
The refinery cost 40 billion Iranian rials and $40 million in hard currency, IRNA reported.
"Once operational the 100,000-tonne coal tar refinery will fetch up to $30 million," the news agency reported.
Rafsanjani was also to open four giant and 20 small industrial and development projects in Isfahan on Monday including the first phase of the Mobarakeh steel complex.
($1=1,750 rials at the official rate used for essential state budget accounts such as oil and major national projects, $1=$3,000 rials at the official rate used in other cases).
